title: Analogue Defaults
summary: My entry into the analog(ue) defaults world
content:
A few months ago, Brad came up with analog defaults loosely based on the Hemispheric Views app defaults. I've been meaning to write mine up but having sat on it for a while I don't think it's worth me having a dedicated page like my app defaults or /now. My personal usage is better served by my #currentlyInked tag for fountain pens and this post as a general overview.

On a Sunday evening if I have time, I sit down and pick out new pens for the week for each category I carry in my Rickshaw Filmore.

  • Fountain pen: I use a single pen each week for my journal although I'll sometimes grab a second one with a different ink colour. Most of my pens are fine or extra fine nib. Currently: Pink Pilot Prera F nib.
  • Pencil: I'm doing more sketches and drawings, especially this month and next, so I always have a pencil or two on me. Currently: Rotring 600 black.
  • Fineliner: This never changes, Sakura Micron is the only way to fly. Uni Pin is fine in a pinch but it's not what I like. I also enjoy using the Lumos Pro Duo.
  • Standard pen: I switch between ballpoints, gels, whatever tickles my pickle that week. Right now? Banana pen.
  • Heading pen: I always use a coloured pen of some kind for headings in my journal. I pick from Gelly Rolls, [Mattehops](https://www.pentel.co.uk/product/pentel-mattehop-1-0mm-k110/, Pentel dual metallics, and Mildliners.
  • Journal: I've tried a bunch of different journals but the one I keep coming back to is Scribbles that Matter Pro.
